::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 6th 1890  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 21
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd),
[Miss Gaye](people/person_552.qmd) wants to have her M S back that she may know what to do with it.

I believe you know [Miss Cheape](people/person_289.qmd)’s address, if she is not at St Andrews, would you get a proof of [Christian](other_books/otherbook_595.qmd) sent to her - I sent up two chapters, but I think I can only put one in. 

[Miss Tanner](people/person_1395.qmd). I think you had better send to the care of 

[Mrs Sidney Lear](people/person_859.qmd)
the Close Salisbury

I do not know who wrote [Tokens](other_books/otherbook_593.qmd) - 

I suppose I told you that the [Grey Woman](other_books/otherbook_594.qmd), in the Christmas number is by Miss Benson the [Archbishop](people/person_140.qmd)’s daughter[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: ‘The Grey Woman’ is a harrowing tale signed ‘A.E.D.’, which appeared in the *MP* Christmas number (1889).  Two letters in the Bodleian Library to [Margaret Benson](people/person_1858.qmd) suggest she was a contributor, though neither seems to refer to this story directly.
